answers.explanation: A subnet is public because its route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to an Internet Gateway — not because of the subnet name. Night 8 Block 1.
ECR image pulls need ecr.api + ecr.dkr interface endpoints; image layers are stored in S3, so an S3 gateway endpoint completes the path without NAT. Night 8 flashcard #5.
NACLs are stateless — you must allow ephemeral return ports explicitly. Security groups are stateful and would have allowed the return traffic. Night 8 Block 1 / Night 6 Q5.
NAT Gateway must live in a public subnet (IGW route) so it can reach the internet on behalf of private subnets. Night 8 Block 1.
NAT is outbound-only from the private subnet side — internet cannot initiate connections to private IPs through NAT. Night 8 Block 1.
S3 gateway endpoints are free and keep S3 traffic off the NAT. Night 8 flashcard #3 / week2-vpc-plan.md.
A bastion (jump host) in a public subnet is the classic pattern for SSH into private EC2. Night 8 bastion discussion.
Session Manager provides shell access over SSM without public IPs or open port 22 — preferred over bastion per week2-vpc-plan.md.
DynamoDB supports a gateway VPC endpoint (like S3). Traffic stays on the AWS network and avoids NAT. Night 8 exam scenario sketch.
Reference the source security group ID, not 0.0.0.0/0 or broad CIDR — least privilege and works as ENIs change. Night 8 exam scenario sketch.
